resources.string: Full page: arrival time, time to go with its uncertainty, pace vs plan or mandatory arrival time and margin
Estimated arrival time from your learned speed per gradient and surface, not a distance / average-speed guess
Estimated time to go, with the uncertainty of the estimate in the label
Remaining distance to the point farthest from the start (e.g. the turnaround on an out-and-back)
Arrival time at the next POI placed on the route (a meeting point, a hut), with the same model as the finish; moves on to the following POI once passed
Mandatory time of arrival asked at ride start and the minutes of slack against it (green ahead, red late)
Riding time against the first estimate of the ride: +4m = arriving later than planned
Tap the field to move the mandatory arrival time and to switch the other extensions on or off during the ride
